in_marathi.name: Arunkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun's chariot, warrior god
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arunkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Arunkumar is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘arun’ which means ‘red’ or ‘dawn’, and ‘kumar’ which means ‘younger brother of Lord Krishna’. This name signifies the one who is as radiant as the sun at dawn. It is also the name of Lord Arun, the god of rain in Hindu mythology.
